definitions.t_write_check_ns: Clock read of the final deadline check, taken immediately before the first Transport::write is called. Not a time inside the write call and not a send boundary.
definitions.t_boundary_ns: Clock read after write and flush returned. A send time only if SendTime::Qualified.
definitions.response_binding: Two layers. Connection: one request in flight per connection (AwaitingResponse until its response was completely framed and consumed; HTTP/1.1 in order; a connection with a misunderstood response is never reused). JSON-RPC body, HTTP 200 only: jsonrpc "2.0" and id equal to the request id (the BUY hash). HTTP 429 is bound by the connection alone; its complete HTTP body is consumed for framing but its contents are not interpreted. Any other non-200 status moves nothing.
definitions.ack: HTTP 200, matching version and id, and a result of exactly 0x followed by 64 hex digits (a bundle hash). Anything else is UnexpectedResult.
